name: set_container_css
description: Replace the container's CSS declarations (display is separate: use set_container_property).

name: set_container_property
description: Set one container property, display included; an empty value removes it.

name: add_item
description: Add an item at the end; it gets the next free id (item-1, item-2, …).

name: reorder_items
description: Move an item to index (0 is first): the order the preview lays items out in.

name: css
description: The layout as a stylesheet: .container and one rule per item.

name: layout_summary
description: The display, the container's declarations, its grid tracks or flex direction, each item's declarations and the warnings.
